description: List the lessons this server can start, from BUNDLES_ROOT and the learner's library, read afresh (a lesson written a moment ago is listed): bundle_ref (pass it to start_lesson_session), title, language, concepts, who wrote it (authoring.mode, drafted_by), and with learner_id the learner's status (new | in_progress | completed). `query` keeps the lessons whose title, ref, discipline or concepts contain every word of it. display_markdown is the list in `language`, ready to show.

language.description: fr or en: the language of display_markdown and of the next step; defaults to the language of the learner's last lesson, else the server's

name: list_lessons
